split_policy.primary_axis: parser behavior and parser rejection contract before manifest case id, README prose, fixture filename, legacy-looking spelling, diagnostic-code label, generated row, report row, old-mode label, shim label, fallback label, compatibility label, or migration label
split_policy.positive_rule: parser-conformance positives are limited to hand-authored accepted canonical Objective-C 3 parser fixtures; accept_void_pointer_param.objc3 is the only positive behavior fixture in this family
split_policy.canonical_rejection_rule: rejected manifest cases are hard-cutover parser rejection evidence for removed declaration spellings, malformed punctuation, duplicate modifiers, misplaced qualifiers, and noncanonical type syntax, not alternate parser acceptance paths
split_policy.strict_error_rule: manifest diagnostic_code values O3P114, O3P104, O3P100, and O3P181 own strict parser diagnostic evidence when paired with their rejected source fixtures; missing or widened diagnostic ownership is strict-error evidence
split_policy.provenance_rule: README prose, manifest case ids, fixture paths, expect labels, diagnostic-code labels, corpus contract id, and owner-split routing rows remain provenance unless parser or rejection owners claim the behavior boundary
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode parser rows, shim parser rows, fallback parser rows, compatibility parser rows, migration-only parser rows, generated-only rows, report-only rows, legacy-looking positives, alternate parser acceptance paths, and rejected rows promoted as support are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
